answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume, a primary-vendor switch or source addition creates unacceptable near-term continuity risk. Incumbent continuity has avoided migration and delivery interruption, while prior renewal benchmarking and multi-year commitments improved price and payment terms. Verify the prior renegotiation record, then pursue an incumbent agreement targeted at the mandated spend reduction without reducing service or delivery protections. The 18% requirement may not be achievable through negotiation alone, so do not assume savings until terms are validated.
